title: 500M language baseline limitations
purpose: Separate observed generation failures from corpus and engineering approvals.
summary: The preserved checkpoint does not demonstrate reliable conversational generation in the assessed panel.

metrics.name: Token-limit stops
metrics.scope: Stopping outcome; not alone a quality failure

methodology: Reuse the preserved 400 generations and checkpoint-blinded independent judgments; no new scoring or inference.
Report automatic stopping/repetition and subjective rubric dimensions separately.
results: Locally grammatical sentences and partial relevance occur, but sustained coherent complete responses were not demonstrated.
limitations: Only 20 contexts support the reviewed panel; 300 outputs have automatic metrics only.
This panel cannot causally separate comprehension from free-running generation failure.
next_actions: Keep SFT deferred until the separately specified base-language gate passes.
After a future continuation, compare identical protected prompts and settings with blinded scoring.
takeaway: The 500M baseline still fails the assessed conversational-generation panel.
